elements.text:
Your family convinces you to go on a walk through a local park. You have heard that there are poisonous snakes in that park.

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I meet my family at the park entrance.
I put on my shoes and head out the door.
I consider bailing on my family, but push myself to go on the walk anyway.
I want to avoid going to the park, but challenge myself to go.
I tell my family that I'm not feeling well and that I can't go.
